## File: facebookresearch_projectariatools/projects/AriaEverydayActivities/python/TestBindings.py

Prompts

```
['test the AriaEverydayActivitiesDataPathsProvider to query location, script, sequence, and recording numbers from an AEA dataset path', 'test the AriaEverydayActivitiesDataProvider to access VRS streams, device calibration, and speech data from an AEA sequence', 'test the MpsDataPathsProvider to retrieve eyegaze and SLAM data paths and compare them with AEA MPS paths', 'test the speech data provider to retrieve sentence data by timestamp and verify start and end timestamps', 'test the MPS integration to retrieve general eyegaze yaw and pitch values at a given timestamp']
```

Usage

```
{'test_AriaEverydayActivitiesDataPathsProvider': 'test the AriaEverydayActivitiesDataPathsProvider to query location, script, sequence, and recording numbers from an AEA dataset path', 'test_AriaEverydayActivitiesDataProvider': 'test the AriaEverydayActivitiesDataProvider to access VRS streams, device calibration, and speech data from an AEA sequence', 'test_MpsDataPathsProvider': 'test the MpsDataPathsProvider to retrieve eyegaze and SLAM data paths and compare them with AEA MPS paths', 'test_speech_sentence_lookup': 'test the speech data provider to retrieve sentence data by timestamp and verify start and end timestamps', 'test_eyegaze_data_retrieval': 'test the MPS integration to retrieve general eyegaze yaw and pitch values at a given timestamp'}
```
